clauses.evidence: E02-S08#AC4 (all fields except SNG level); SNG level restore is checked by E05-S03#AC4 (tagged REQ-008.3, not REQ-004.3)
E02-S01#AC1 and E02-S12#AC1 (logo on Home/Splash); colours by E03-S16#AC2; app icon by E13-S06#AC3

findings.evidence: E02-S09 (TASK-2.7, m-1, ordinal 56000) AC2 requires 'its Session Report is saved' on confirm. Report saving is E10-S01 (TASK-10.1, m-1, ordinal 58000, built later). The story's own Notes say 'Order this after E10's report-saving story', but its only dependency is TASK-2.6; TASK-10.1 is not listed.
findings.fix: Add TASK-10.1 (E10-S01) as a dependency of E02-S09 so it is ordered after the report-saving story, or move the 'report saved' part into an E10 AC.

findings.evidence: E02-S08 (TASK-2.6, 8 ACs) combines Resume entry on Home (AC1-2), mid-hand abandonment and restore (AC3-6) and the new Table-header Home control (AC7-8, REQ-004.9) which also edits the Table screen owned by E03.
findings.fix: Split the Home control (REQ-004.9) into its own story; keep resume and restore here.

findings.evidence: E02-S04#AC3 (pre-select the last started game type) implements part of REQ-012.1 'remember last configuration' that E02-S10 (m-2, Low) owns; it needs a last-session store that S10 is meant to create, and S04 (High, m-1) would otherwise have to build it. The two stories overlap and S04's priority hinges on a Could clause.
findings.fix: Move AC3 into E02-S10 (and keep REQ-005.1 'default is last used' there) or create the last-configuration store explicitly in an earlier story that both depend on.

findings.evidence: E02-S03#AC5 ('every screen and dialog of the app is inspected ... bundle uses no payment API') is an app-wide audit placed in a stake-selection story; it is not testable as a single pass/fail within this slice and makes the story cover two capabilities (stake choice, no real-money features).
findings.fix: Move REQ-006.3/REQ-061.1 into a global DoD item or a checklist AC on a cross-cutting story, with concrete assertions (no payment/deposit text or API in the bundle).

findings.evidence: E02-S01#AC1 tags REQ-060.3 but asserts only the logo and name (theme colours are in the description, not an AC); AC5 (Cancel returns Home, no session) tags REQ-002.2, which is about New game opening Game Config; E02-S02#AC6 tags REQ-005.2 for a heads-up blind rule.
findings.fix: Remove the tags that the ACs do not confirm or add an AC with the charcoal background and red accent values for Home.

findings.evidence: REQ-004.3 lists SNG level among restored items. E02-S08#AC4 covers the rest; the SNG level restore is checked by E05-S03#AC4 and #AC5 but those ACs are tagged REQ-008.3 only, so the RTM shows REQ-004.3 covered by one cash-only AC.
findings.fix: Tag E05-S03#AC4 with REQ-004.3 (or add an SNG resume AC tagged REQ-004.3).

findings.evidence: E02-S11#AC4/AC5 (50 bot actions at Realistic 0.8-3.0 s, Rapid 300 ms) duplicate the pacing ACs E03-S13#AC1-3 for REQ-011.1/.2 while the description says pacing is implemented by E03-S13.
findings.fix: Keep one owner of REQ-011.1/.2 (E03-S13) and limit E02-S11 to choosing and pre-filling the speed, or state that the ACs here verify the chosen value reaches the table.

summary: All 40 clauses substantively covered. One HIGH hidden dependency (E02-S09 needs the E10 report-saving story but does not depend on it). Oversized E02-S08, overlap between E02-S04 and E02-S10, and a few weak tags; no false claims on Must clauses.
